description: Estimate the carbon emissions of web pages with Website Carbon, the keyless API from Wholegrain Digital that powers websitecarbon.com. Give a page's weight in bytes and whether it is on green hosting, and get the CO2e a single visit costs, the page's Digital Carbon Rating from A+ to F, and how it compares with the pages measured across the web. Project that against real traffic for a monthly and yearly footprint, weigh up a move to renewable hosting, rank a set of pages to find what is worth optimising, price a download or a month of CDN traffic, and fail a build when a page goes over its carbon budget. No account or API key is required.
